$comment: Sample request args with invented values. Run keel review prepare with the selected request as JSON on stdin, parse stdout and pass {...request, prepared} to lens-review. This skips the preparation agent. Audit and verification default to opus/high; fallback prepare and reporter default to sonnet/low (override independently with mechanicalModel). A root review omits since, runId and rootRunId; a delta gives since on every diff plus rootRunId, and priorFindings after NEEDS_FIXES. Omit lenses to use workflows/review-lenses.json. Start a fresh Claude session after changing workflow files.
